from.place: Proof step 1: injective-target derived homology comparison

title: Surjectivity of the degree-zero homology map from morphisms into an injective single object.
statement: For an abelian category A with a chosen derived category, K in D(A), and injective I in A, the degree-zero homology map from morphisms K to I[0] to morphisms between degree-zero homology objects is surjective.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_homology_injective_surjective
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (I : A) [Injective I] :
    Function.Surjective
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).map :
        (K ⟶ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj I) →
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).obj K ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj I)))
